note: Move effect constants (constants/move_effect_constants.asm) with the MoveEffectPointerTable handler.

effects.description: Deals damage, nothing else.
Unused; dispatches to SleepEffect (listed with the sleep effects in the AI tables).
Damage + 52/256 (~20%) chance to poison. No effect on Poison types, statused targets or a Substitute.
Damage; user regains half the damage dealt (minimum 1).
Damage + 26/256 (~10%) chance to burn (not if the target shares the move type or is statused). Hitting a frozen target with a Fire move that can burn thaws it.
Damage + 26/256 (~10%) chance to freeze (not Ice types). Freezing clears the target's Hyper Beam recharge (enemy side only).
Damage + 26/256 (~10%) chance to paralyze (not if the target shares the move type). Speed is quartered.
User faints after the attack (even if it misses). The target's Defense is halved (min 1) in the damage formula.
Fails unless the target is asleep; user regains half the damage dealt.
Uses the move the opponent last used (fails if none, or if that was Mirror Move).
Raises the user's Attack by 1 stage (max +6).
Raises the user's Defense by 1 stage.
Raises the user's Speed by 1 stage.
Raises the user's Special by 1 stage.
Raises the user's accuracy by 1 stage.
Raises the user's evasion by 1 stage.
Damage; scatters 2 x user level in money, paid out after a win.
Damage; MoveHitTest returns before any check, so it never misses - not even a target in the invulnerable turn of Fly/Dig.
Lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage (min -6). Accuracy-checked; blocked by Mist/Substitute; the AI's version has an extra 64/256 fail chance.
Lowers the target's Defense by 1 stage (see ATTACK_DOWN1_EFFECT).
Lowers the target's Speed by 1 stage (see ATTACK_DOWN1_EFFECT).
Lowers the target's Special by 1 stage (see ATTACK_DOWN1_EFFECT).
Lowers the target's accuracy by 1 stage (see ATTACK_DOWN1_EFFECT).
Lowers the target's evasion by 1 stage (see ATTACK_DOWN1_EFFECT).
User's types become the target's types (fails if the target is in Fly/Dig).

Resets every stat stage on both sides; cures the target's non-volatile status (a sleeping/frozen target loses its turn); clears confusion, Leech Seed, Mist, Focus Energy, X Accuracy, Toxic, Reflect, Light Screen and Disable on both sides.
Stores energy for 2-3 turns, then deals twice the damage taken meanwhile.
Attacks for 2-3 turns in a row, then the user becomes confused for 2-5 turns.
Ends a wild battle. Fails in trainer battles. If the user is lower level than the target: succeeds when rand(0..userLv+targetLv) >= targetLv/4.
Hits 2-5 times (2:3/8, 3:3/8, 4:1/8, 5:1/8); damage is computed once and reused.
Unused alias of TWO_TO_FIVE_ATTACKS_EFFECT.
Damage + 26/256 (~10%) chance to flinch (only matters if the user moved first).
Puts the target to sleep for 1-7 turns. Fails on an already statused target; always lands on a target recharging from Hyper Beam.
Damage + 103/256 (~40%) chance to poison.
Damage + 77/256 (~30%) chance to burn.
Unused (30% freeze; Blizzard in JP Red/Green).
Damage + 77/256 (~30%) chance to paralyze.
Damage + 77/256 (~30%) chance to flinch.
One-hit KO (damage 65535). Fails if the user's current Speed is lower than the target's; accuracy check still applies.
Charges on the first turn, attacks on the second (Dig: invulnerable while underground).
Deals half the target's current HP (minimum 1). In SetDamageEffects: skips the damage formula and the type chart (hits Ghost types); the accuracy check applies.

Fixed damage: Seismic Toss/Night Shade = user level; Sonic Boom = 20; Dragon Rage = 40; Psywave = random in [1, 1.5*level) for the player, [0, 1.5*level) for the enemy. Skips the type chart (Seismic Toss hits Ghosts, Night Shade hits Normals); accuracy check applies.
Binds the target for 2-5 turns (3/8, 3/8, 1/8, 1/8); the target cannot act; later hits repeat the first hit's damage.
Flies up on turn 1 (invulnerable to most moves), attacks on turn 2.
Hits exactly twice.
If it misses, the user takes 1 HP crash damage (intended damage/8, but the damage is already 0 after a miss).
Protects the user's side from stat-lowering moves.
Sets the "getting pumped" flag - which, because of a bug, divides the critical-hit chance by 4 instead of raising it.
User takes 1/4 of the damage dealt as recoil (Struggle: 1/2), minimum 1.
Confuses the target for 2-5 turns (fails if already confused or behind a Substitute).
Raises the user's Attack by 2 stages.
Raises the user's Defense by 2 stages.
Raises the user's Speed by 2 stages.
Raises the user's Special by 2 stages.
Raises the user's accuracy by 2 stages.
Raises the user's evasion by 2 stages.
Recover/Softboiled heal half max HP; Rest heals fully, cures status and sleeps 2 turns. Fails at full HP (bug: also fails when maxHP - HP is exactly 255 or 511).
User copies the target's species, types, DVs, Attack/Defense/Speed/Special, stat stages and moves (5 PP each).
Lowers the target's Attack by 2 stages.
Lowers the target's Defense by 2 stages.
Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages.
Lowers the target's Special by 2 stages.
Lowers the target's accuracy by 2 stages.
Lowers the target's evasion by 2 stages.
Doubles the user's Special against special-type moves until it switches out (ignored by critical hits).
Doubles the user's Defense against physical-type moves until it switches out (ignored by critical hits).
Poisons the target (Toxic: badly poisoned, damage N/16 rising each turn). Fails on Poison types/statused targets/Substitute.
Paralyzes the target (Electric-type paralysis moves do not affect Ground types).
Damage + 85/256 (~33%) chance to lower the target's Attack 1 stage.
Damage + 85/256 (~33%) chance to lower the target's Defense 1 stage.
Damage + 85/256 (~33%) chance to lower the target's Speed 1 stage.
Damage + 85/256 (~33%) chance to lower the target's Special 1 stage.
Damage + 25/256 (~10%) chance to confuse.
Hits twice; afterwards behaves as POISON_SIDE_EFFECT1 (52/256 poison).
User pays 1/4 of max HP to make a Substitute with that much HP (bug: can leave the user at 0 HP).
User must recharge next turn - unless the attack missed or knocked out the target.
User is locked into Rage; each time it is hit its Attack rises 1 stage.
Replaces Mimic with one of the target's moves until the battle ends (player picks; AI picks at random).
Uses a random move: any move id 1-164 except Metronome.
Seeds the target (not Grass types): each turn 1/16 max HP is drained to the opponent (multiplied by the Toxic counter - Leech Seed/Toxic glitch).
No effect ("No effect!").
Disables a random move of the target for 1-8 turns (fails if one is already disabled).
